valley.drawingAlt: [PLACEHOLDER] A ring of toadstools under one rain cloud. Four stakes mark where the rain can fall.
locals: [PLACEHOLDER] The cloud goes where the most of us point.
[PLACEHOLDER] Mossbank and Rootstep split our votes again.

notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] The split vote
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] When two near spots share their friends, a third spot can win with fewer.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] Real elections have many more voters and reasons.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] Plurality is simple, and simple has value.
notes.question: [PLACEHOLDER] Which rule would you trust?

sources.label: To Build a Better Ballot, Nicky Case

notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Other ways to count
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] Approval, runoff, and score count the same wishes in other ways.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] No rule is fair in every case.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] A rule that finds a compromise can leave nobody glad.
notes.question: [PLACEHOLDER] What does a rule hide?

sources.label: To Build a Better Ballot, Nicky Case
